galleryLayout.shortLandscape: width < 1024 and height < 520; vertical gallery with scrollable right menu
galleryLayout.toneSampling: elementsFromPoint at label center; respects current animated panel clip
galleryLayout.heightResize: Preserve gallery geometry on unchanged-width mobile viewport-height changes.
galleryLayout.desktopSettle: Release predicts nearest landing; wheel hands off after 60 ms input silence before stopping. Velocity-preserving critical damping coordinates scroll, expansion and navigation, with anchor compensation and edge clamps.
galleryLayout.phoneSettle: Native held/fast touch scrolling; released momentum below 0.6 px/ms transfers measured velocity into coordinated settlement. Event-gap fallback 60 ms; no settlement while touch is held.

navigationGeometry.markerPlacement: Below the title in the desktop bottom dock; right of the title in the mobile right rail.
navigationGeometry.labelSlot: Desktop: 90 px centered, 82 px at 768–1000 px and height >= 520 px, center-bottom transform origin. Mobile: 70 px right-aligned, right-center origin.
navigationGeometry.markerGap: Desktop 14 px; mobile 12 px, 10 px below 360 px.
navigationGeometry.labelScale: .92 + .26 * influence(position - index); influence(d) = t*t*(3 - 2*t), t = clamp(1 - abs(d), 0, 1)
navigationGeometry.sharedState: Browse/scrub: omega 2/65 per ms. During settlement: same adaptive critically damped rate as scroll and scene expansion, base omega 1/130 per ms; no extra indicator delay. Title scale and liquid geometry share position/velocity.
navigationGeometry.retargeting: Preserve liquid position and velocity when click, drag, wheel, or scrub changes target; clamp position to entry range.
navigationGeometry.markerTone: Same neutral gray for line, circle and connecting head; only current label blue.
navigationGeometry.transfer: Strictly horizontal on desktop and vertical on phone. Neck length uses traveled marker distance times velocity-based smoothstep, contracting as velocity falls. No arc; visible SVG overflow.
navigationGeometry.scrubHysteresis: 8 px beyond midpoint for preview label only
navigationGeometry.releaseSelection: Recompute progress from actual pointer-up coordinate and round to nearest entry, independent of animated position.
navigationGeometry.previewLimit: Static snippets show final states; actual gallery transfer is driven by hub.js and motion.js, with workspace adaptation in homework/nav.js.
navigationGeometry.compactDesktop: 82 px centered label, 22 × 2 px marker layout box, 14 px gap; 768–1000 px wide and height >= 520 px
navigationGeometry.transferCleanup: Settled endpoints: exact zero velocity, opacity 0, empty path. Invisible frames empty path. Retargeting retains velocity; lost capture cancels toward retained state. Visibility/layout resets clear transfer and initialize settled state.

narrative.overview:
Seven authentic economic learning destinations share one continuous diagonal gallery. Physical paper, the original pixel canyon, academic folios, and the NEBS competition artwork retain their recognizable material character. A transparent floating title and transparent destination menu let these worlds supply the full page surface.

Chinese serif headings and restrained Latin display type establish hierarchy without extra explanatory copy. Selection expands a scene and restores its color; entering remains a separate action. A neutral liquid guide connects the fixed navigation items, while their labels scale gently around the traveling focus. This is an approved interaction extension of the incumbent visual world, recorded from the final stylesheet cascade: artwork.css, hub.css, premium.css, mobile.css, courses.css, then floating.css; geometry and interaction come from hub.js and motion.js.

The electronic homework workspace is an ordinary extension of this frame. Its first gallery entry reuses the course folio; inside `/homework/`, a navy surround supports an ivory paper sheet, Chinese serif task headings, restrained system-sans forms, and a transparent shared-motion dock. Uploaded work and editable assessment content supply the detail. The workspace adds only scoped tokens from `homework/style.css`; its original-motion adapter is `homework/nav.js`.

The approved unified entry extends this world with a navy page, a warm paper form, a white Chinese title and a compact preview of Bookself, EconQuest and electronic homework. The desktop preview occupies diagonal monochrome panels beside the form; on phones it becomes a short branded strip above the form. These are the implemented expressions of the user-approved login composition, not a replacement identity. The signed-in account menu uses a small paper-backed disclosure at the top right.
keyCharacteristics: Original wordmarks, book covers, model interface, pixel teachers, Wolai icon, and NEBS poster remain the visual evidence.
The unified entry places a navy primary action on warm paper; registration, recovery and form errors remain in the same surface.
A white Chinese serif title and M/book-page mark float over the gallery with soft navy shadows and a fully transparent background.
Seven fixed shortcuts use neutral line/circle guides below desktop titles and to the right of phone titles; only the current label uses blue.
Physical books and archive folios retain visible page edges and restrained cast shadows.
The homework workspace pairs real answer artifacts with editable fields on a single native-scrolling ivory sheet, keeping private references distinct from published feedback.
Continuous diagonal expansion, native phone scrolling, separate entry links, keyboard access, and instant reduced-motion states preserve clear navigation.
The teacher workspace keeps one continuous ivory surface, with persistent teaching context, native homework reuse and activity-first evidence.

rules.name: The Visible Task Rule
rules.body: On phones, a table with an action column becomes labeled, stacked rows with the action visible in the content lane. Dense comparison tables retain semantic columns, keyboard-focusable horizontal scrolling and a visible “左右滑动查看完整表格” cue. The approved minimum for phone buttons is (44 px); bottom navigation targets are at least (48 px).

rules.name: The Evidence First Rule
rules.body: Game concepts with attempts, errors or revisits appear first with their distinct counts and next action, followed by classroom tasks and submitted writing. Unattempted concepts remain reachable in a counted, initially collapsed native disclosure. An absence of activity is stated explicitly. This is a teacher-surface rule, not a new ordering rule for student gameplay.

dos: Do preserve the navy-and-paper login hierarchy, visible field labels and same-surface error/recovery states.
Do retain a reachable account reconnection action after a temporary session-service failure.
Do preserve the original assets, licensed fonts, URLs, and provenance, including the Wolai 🤯 icon as observed brand truth.
Do keep the gallery title and destination-menu backgrounds transparent, with the documented shadows providing contrast; retain the approved paper-backed account control.
Do keep neutral markers below desktop titles and to the right of phone titles, with blue only on the current label.
Do scale labels continuously around traveling focus while keeping gallery phone hit targets fixed at 44 px high; homework phone targets remain at least 48 px high.
Do maintain proportional artwork, continuous diagonal seams, and separate selection and entry actions.
Do preserve native phone scrolling, keyboard access, immediate interruption, and instant reduced-motion states.
Do keep homework scrolling inside the paper sheet, preserving its right-side mobile dock lane and legible 16 px form fields.
Do distinguish private reference material, rubric versions, teacher review and published feedback with clear text and states.
Do keep teacher actions visible in the phone content lane, reserve bottom-navigation clearance and preserve the approved 44 px minimum for phone buttons.
donts: Don’t treat the filled account disclosure as part of the transparent destination dock.
Don’t replace inherited gallery motion or identity artwork as part of authentication work.
Don’t restore group pagination, a sticky navy masthead, or a horizontal phone shortcut row from older files.
Don’t use an independent blue droplet, blue guide fill, filled pill, or translucent backing in the gallery destination dock.
Don’t recolor, stretch, or replace original assets with generic substitutes.
Don’t describe decorative folio compositions as existing downloadable books or NEBS gradient crops as organic cutouts.
Don’t let pointer hover override a pinned selection or expose a hidden entry link to interaction.
Don’t add autoplay decoration, a second phone momentum engine, an entrance blocker, or a cursor replacement.
Don’t introduce repeated uppercase eyebrows, Unicode action glyphs or synthetic document decoration into the homework form hierarchy.
Don’t copy the standalone homework outer shell into the teacher host or replace native teacher modules with iframes.
